If k or k+1 is m=2^s>=8, the remaining quotient has denominator (1+q^m). Numerator includes 1+q^(3m), quotient exactly 1-q^m+q^(2m). With h=m/8, the five distinct available nonpower-of-2 factors indexed T+=(3,5,6,7,10)h, except (m,b)=(8,7) where T-=(3,5,6,10,14)h, yield P±(q^h).
